G3900.def:
παρά-πτωρμα, -τος, τό
(παραπίπτω), [in LXX for מַעַל, פֶּשַׁע, etc. ;]
__1. a false step, a blunder (Polyb.).
__2. Ethically, a misdeed, trespass (LXX): Mt 6:14-15, Mc 11:25-26, Rm 4:25 5:15 ff Rm 11:11-12, 2Co 5:19, Gl 6:1, Ef 1:7 2:1, 5, Cl 2:13.†
SYN.: see: ἁμαρτία (AS)

G3901.def:
παρα-ρρέω
[in LXX: Is 44:4 (יָבַל), Pv 3:21 * ;]
to flow by, drift away, slip away: Hb 2:1.†
(AS)

G3902.def:
παράσημος, -ον
(σῆμα, a mark) [in LXX: 3Ma.2:29 * ;]
__1. in cl., marked amiss, spurious, counterfeit. Later,
__2. marked at the side, annotated (Plut.).
__3. marked with a sign (LXX); as subst., a figure­head : At 28:11 (see MM, xix).†
(AS)

G3903.def:
παρα-σκευάζω
[in LXX: Jr 50:42 (עָרַךְ), etc. ;]
to prepare, make ready: absol. (sc. τ. δεῖπνον, etc.; of. Hdt., ix, 82, 2Ma.2:27), At 10:10; mid., to prepare, make preparations: 1Co 14:8 (cf. Je, l.with); pass., 2Co 9:2-3.†
(AS)

G3904.def:
παρα-σκευή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Êx 35:24 39:42 (עֲבֹדָה, with seel., ἀποσκ-, κατασκ-), Jdth.2:17 4:5, 1Ma.9:35 א, 2Ma.15:21 * ;]
__1. preparation.
__2. equipment (Jth, ll with).
__3. In Jewish usage, the day of preparation for a Sabbath or a feast (= προσάββατον, which see) : Mt 27:62, Mc 15:42, Lc 23:54, Jo 19:31; with genitive, τοῦ πάσχα, Jo 19:14; τ. Ἰoυδαίων, Jo 19:42 (it is the name for Friday in MGr.).†
(AS)

G3905.def:
παρα-τείνω
[in LXX: Nm 23:28 (שָׁקַף ni.), etc. ;]
to extend, pro­long: τ. λόγον, At 20:7.†
(AS)

G3906.def:
παρα-τηρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sl 37:12 (זָמַם), Sl 130:8 (שָׁמַר), Da TH Dn 6:11 (12), Su 1:12,15,16* ;]
__1. to watch closely, observe narrowly: so mid., τ. πύλας, At 9:24; with evil intent, Mc 3:2, Lc 20:20 (absol., see Field, Notes, 74); so mid., Lc 6:7 14:1.
__2. to observe scrupulously (of days and seasons; cf. Êx 12:42, Sm.): mid., Gl 4:10.†
(AS)

G3907.def:
παρα-τήρησις, -εως, ἡ
[in Aq.: Êx 12:42 (see: παρατηρέω) * ;]
obser­vation: Lc 17:20 (Polyb., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G3908.def:
παρα-τίθημι
[in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם ;]
__I. Act., to place beside, set before, with accusative and dative: of food, Mc 6:41 8:6-7, Lc 9:16 11:6; τράπεζαν, At 16:34; pass. ptcp., Lc 10:8, 1Co 10:27; metaphorically, of teaching, παραβολήν, Mt 13:24, 31.
__II. Mid.,
__1. to have set before one (Hom., Thuc., Xen., al.).
__2. to deposit with another, give in charge or commit to (Hdt., Xen., Polyb., al.) : with accusative and dative, Lc 12:48 23:46, At 14:23 20:32, 1Tm 1:18, 2Tm 2:2, 1Pe 4:19.
__3. to bring forward, quote as evidence: before ὅτι, At 17:3 (see Page, in l).†
(AS)

G3909.def:
παρα-τυγχάνω
to happen to be near or present: At 17:17.†
(AS)

G3910.def:
παρ-αυτίκα
adv. (πάραυτα = παρ ̓ αὐτά, sc. τὰ πράγματα) [in LXX: Sl 70:3, Tob.4:14 * ;]
__1. immediately.
__2. C. subst., to express brief duration (cf. ἡ π. λαμπρότης, Thuc., ii, 64), momentary, for a moment: 2Co 4:17.†
(AS)

G3911.def:
παρα-φέρω
[in LXX: 1Rs 21:13 (14) (הָלַל hithpo.), and as seel. 2* ;]
__1. to bring to, set before, esp. of food (Hdt., al.).
__2. to take or carry away: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, Mc 14:36, Lc 22:42; pass., before ὑπό, Ju 12; metaphorically, pass., with dative, Hb 13:9.†
(AS)

G3912.def:
παρα-φρονέω
(ιαρά, φρήν), [in LXX: Zc 7:11 (סָרַר)* ;]
to be beside oneself, be deranged: 2Co 11:23.†
(AS)

G3914.def:
παρα-χειμάζω
to winter at a place: before εἰς, At 27:12; ἐν, At 28:11; πρὸς ὑμᾶς, 1Co 16:6; ἐκεῖ, Tt 3:12.†
(AS)

G3916.def:
παραχρῆμα
adv. (= παρὰ τὸ χρῆμα), [in LXX: Nm 6:9 12:4, Is 29:5 30:13 (פִּתְאוֹם), etc. ;]
on the spot, forthwith, instantly: Mt 21:19-20, Lc 1:64 4:39 5:25 8:44, 47 8:55 13:13 18:43 19:11 22:60, At 3:7 5:10 12:23 13:11 16:26, 33 (on the usage in Mt, Lk, see Dalman, Words, 28 f.).†
(AS)

G3917.def:
πάρδαλις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX for נָמֵר, Ct 4:8, Os 13:7, Is 11:6, al. ;]
a panther, leopard: Ap 13:2.†
(AS)

G3918.def:
πάρ-ειμι
[in LXX for בּוֹא, etc. ;]
__1. to be by, at hand or present;
__(a) of persons: Ap 17:8; παρών (opposite to ἀπών), 1Co 5:3, 2Co 10:2 10:11 13:2 13:10; before ἐπί with genitive, At 24:19; ἐνώπιον, At 10:33; ἐνθάδε, At 17:6; πρός, with accusative of person(s), At 12:20, 2Co 11:8, Gl 4:18, 20;
__(b) of things : of time, ὁ καιρός, Jo 7:6; τ. παρόν, Hb 12:11; ἡ ἀλήθεια, 2Pe 1:12; ταῦτα, 2Pe 1:9; τ. παρόντα, Hb 13:5.
__2. to have come or arrived (Hdt., Thuc., al.; see Field, Notes, 65) : Lc 13:1, Jo 11:28, At 10:21; before εἰς, Cl 1:6; before ἐπί, with accusative of thing(s), Mt 26:50 (cf. συν-πάρειμι).†
(AS)

G3919.def:
παρ-εισ-άγω
__1. to lead in by one's side, bring forward, introduce.
__2. In late writers, to introduce or bring in secretly: 2Pe 2:1.†
(AS)

G3920.def:
παρ-είσ-ακτος, -ον
(παρεισάγω),
brought in secretly (as spies or traitors) : Gl 2:4.†
(AS)

G3921.def:
παρ-εισ-δύω
(also -δύνω),
to slip in secretly, steal in: παρεισεδύησαν (vulgar aor.; pass. for act., El., § 19, 2), Ju 4 (cf. also MM, xix).†
(AS)

G3922.def:
παρ-εισ-έρχομαι
__1. to come in beside or by the way: Rm 5:20.
__2. to come in secretly, steal in: Gl 2:4.†
(AS)

G3923.def:
παρ-εισ-φέρω
to bring in or supply besides: σπουδὴν π. (late Gk. for cl. σ. ποιεῖσθαι; cf. Deiss., BS, 361), 2Pe 1:5.†
(AS)

G3924.def:
παρ-εκτός = cl. παρέκ, -έξ,
[in Aq.: Dt 1:36; Al., Lv 23:38 * ;]
__1. as adv., besides, in addition: τὰ π. (sc. γινόμενα), 2Co 11:28.
__2. As prep. with genitive, except: Mt 5:32 19:9 (WH, mg., R, mg.), At 26:29.†
(AS)

G3925.def:
παρ-εμ-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(παρεμβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲנֶה ;]
__1. an insertion, interpolation (Æschin.)
__2. In the Macedonian dialect (Rutherford, NPhr., 473), as a military term;
__(a) an army in battle array: Hb 11:34 (cf. Êx 14:19-20, Jz 4:16, al.; frequently in Polyb.);
__(b) a camp (Êx 29:14, al.) : Hb 13:11, 13 Ap 20:9;
__(with) barracks, soldiers' quarters: At 21:34, 37 22:24 23:10, 16 23:32 28:16 (WH, txt., R, om.).†
παρ-εμ-βάλλω,
[in LXX frequently and chiefly for מַחֲנֶה ;]
__1. to put in beside or between, interpose.
__2. In late writers (Polyb., al., LXX) as technical military term;
__(a) of soldiers, to draw up in line (frequently in 1Ma.2:32, al.);
__(b) of siege works, to cast up: with accusative and dative, χάρακά σοι, Lc 19:43.†
(AS)

G3926.def:
παρ-εν-οχλέω, -ῶ
(cf. ἐνοχλέω), [in LXX for לָאָה hi. (Mq 6:3), etc. ;]
to annoy concerning a matter (παρά): with dative of person(s), At 15:19.†
(AS)

G3927.def:
παρ-επί-δημος, -ον
(see: ἐπιδημέω), [in LXX: Gn 23:4, Sl 39:12 (תּוֹשָׁב)* ;]
sojourning in a strange place; as subst., ὁ π., a sojourner: of Christians, 1Pe 1:1; ξένοι καὶ π., Hb 11:13; πάροικοι καὶ π., 1Pe 2:11 (see Deiss., BS, 149).†
(AS)

G3928.def:
παρ-ἐρχομαι
[in LXX chiefly for עָבַר ;]
__1. to pass, pass by;
__(a) of persons: absol., Lc 18:37; with accusative of person(s), Mc 6:48; with accusative lot., At 16:8; before διά, with genitive, Mt 8:28;
__(b) of things : τ. ποτήριον, Mt 26:39 (ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ), Mt 26:42; of time, Mt 14:15, Mc 14:35, At 27:9, 1Pe 4:3. Metaphorical,
__(a) to pass away, perish: Mt 5:18 24:34-35 Mc 13:30-31, Lc 16:17 21:32-33, 2Co 5:17, Tg 1:10, 2Pe 3:10;
__(b) to pass by, neglect, disregard: with accusative of thing(s), Lc 11:42 15:29.
__2. to come to, arrive: Lc 12:37 17:7, At 24:7, R, mg. (cf. ἀντι-παρέρχομαι).†
SYN.: παραβαίνω (AS)

G3929.def:
πάρεσις, -εως, ἡ
(παρίημι),
__1. a letting go, dismissal.
__2. prætermission, passing by (of debt or sin) : Rm 3:25†
SYN.: ἄφεσις, q.v (AS)

G3930.def:
παρ-έχω
[in LXX: Sl 30:7 (עָמַד hi.), etc. ;]
__I. Active voice.,
__1. to furnish, provide, supply; with ref. to incorporeal things, to afford, show, give, cause: with accusative, At 22:2, 1Tm 1:4; with accusative and dative, Mt 26:10, Mc 14:6, Lc 11:7 18:5, At 16:16 17:31 28:2, Gl 6:17, 1Tm 6:17.
__2. to present, offer: with accusative and dative, Lc 6:29; with prop. reflex. and accusative pred., to show or present oneself (see infr., and cf. B1., § 55, 1).
__II. Middle voice.,
__1. to supply, furnish or display of one's own part: with accusative and dative, Lc 7:4, At 19:24, Cl 4:1.
__2. In late writers, with prop. reflex. and accusative pred. (= act. ut supr.), to show or present oneself (Xen., FlJ, al.; cf. M, Pr., 248; Deiss., BS, 254) : Tt 2:7.†
(AS)

G3931.def:
παρηγορία, -ας, ἡ
(παρηγορέω, to address, exhort, console) [in LXX: 4Ma.5:12 4Mac 6:1 * ;]
__1. an address, exhortation (LXX, ll. with).
__2. comfort, consolation: Cl 4:11.†
(AS)

G3933.def:
παρθένος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for בְּתוּלָה, Êx 22:16 (15), Jó 31:1, Is 23:4, al.; also for נַעַר, נַעֲרָה, Gn 24:14, 16 24:55 34:3, and for עַלְמָה, Gn 24:43, Is 7:14 ;]
a maiden, virgin: Mt 1:23 (LXX) Mt 25:1, 7 25:11 Lc 1:27, At 21:9, 1Co 7:25 ff, 2Co 11:2; masc., of chaste persons (CIG, 8784 b) : Ap 14:4.†
(AS)

G3935.def:
παρ-ίημι
[in LXX: Jr 4:31 (פָּרַשׂ pi.), etc. ;]
__1. to pass by or over, let alone, disregard: Lc 11:42.
__2. to relax, loosen; pass., to be relaxed, weakened, exhausted: παρειμένας χεῖρας, Hb 12:12 (LXX ἀνειμ-).†
(AS)

G3936.def:
παρ-ίστημι
[in LXX for עָמַד, etc. ;]
__I. Transitive verb. in present tense., imperfect., future tense., 1 aorist.;
__1. to place beside, present, provide: with accusative, At 9:41 23:24, 2Co 4:14, Cl 1:28; with accusative and dative, Mt 26:53, Lc 2:22, At 1:3 23:33, 1Co 8:8; before accusative pred., Rm 6:13, 16 (late pres., παριστάνετε), Rm 6:19 12:1, 2Co 11:2, Ef 5:27, Cl 1:22, 2Tm 2:15.
__2. to present to the mind (cl.) : by argument, to prove (Xen., FlJ, al.), with accusative, At 24:13.
__II. Intransitive. in perfect., pluperfect., 2 aorist.;
__1. to stand by or beside one : with dative of person(s), At 1:10 9:39 23:2 27:23; ptcp., Mc 14:47, 69-70 15:35, 39 Jo 18:22 19:26.
__2. to appear: with nom. pred., before ἐνώπιον, At 4:10; with dative of person(s), At 27:24; so fut. mid. (of. LS, see word, B, ii, 2), Rm 14:10.
__3. to be at hand, be present, have come: At 4:26 (LXX); of servants in attendance, ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, Lc 1:19; absol., οἱ παρεστῶτες, Lc 19:24; before αὐτῷ, At 23:2, 4; of time, Mc 4:29
__4. to stand by for help or defence (Hom., Dem., Xen., al.): with dative of person(s), Rm 16:2, 2Tm 4:17.†
(AS)

G3938.def:
πάρ-οδος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX: Gn 38:14 (דֶּרֶךְ), etc. ;]
a passing or passage: ἐν π., in passing, 1Co 16:7.†
(AS)

G3939.def:
παρ-οικέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for גּוּר, also for יָשַׁב, שָׁכַן ]
in cl., to dwell beside (with accusative), among (with dative) or near by (absol.). In late writers, to dwell in a place as a πάροικος (which see) or stranger: Lc 24:18, Hb 11:9.†
(AS)

G3940.def:
παρ-οικία, -ας, ἡ
(παροικέω, which see), [in LXX: Et 8:35 (גּוֹלָה), Sl 34:4 55:15 119:54 120:5, La 2:22 (מָגוֹר; and cogn. forms), Hc 3:16, I Et 5:7, Jdth.5:9, Wis.19:10, Sir prol. Sir.1:26 16:8 41:5 44:6, 3Ma.6:36 3Mac 7:19 * ;]
a sojourning: At 13:17, 1Pe 1:17.†
(AS)

G3941.def:
άρ-οικος, -ον
[in LXX chiefly for גֵּר, תּוֹשָׁב ;]
__1. in cl. Attic, dwelling near, neighbouring; as subst., a neighbour.
__2. In late writers (LXX, Philo) and in Iuser. (Deiss., BS, 227 f.; Kennedy, Sources, 102), foreign, alien; as subst., an alien, a sojourner: At 7:6 (LXX), At 7:29; metapb., ξένοι καὶ π. (opposite to συμπολίτης), Ef 2:19; π. καὶ παρεπιδήμους (which see), 1Pe 2:11 (see Lft. on Clem. Rom., 1 Co., § 1).†
(AS)

G3942.def:
παροιμία, -ας, ἡ
(πάροιμος, by the way), [in LXX. Pr title Pv 1:1 25:1, (מָשַׁל) subscr., Sir.6:35 8:8 18:29 39:3 47:17 * ;]
__1. a wayside saying (Hesych.; see LS, see word), a byword, maxim, proverb: 2Pe 2:22.
__2. In NT, of figurative discourse (as מָשַׁל, Is 14:4, al.), a parable, allegory: Jo 10:6 16:25, 29 (see Abbott, Essays, 82 ff.).†
SYN.: παραβολή, q.v (AS)

G3943.def:
πάρ-οινος, -ον
= cl., παροινικός (παρά, οἶνος),
given to wine, drunken: 1Tm 3:3, Tt 1:7.†
(AS)

G3944.def:
παρ-οίχομαι
to have passed by; of time, to be gone by: ἐν τ. παρῳχημέναις γενεαῖς, At 14:16.†
(AS)

G3947.def:
παρ-οξύνω
[in LXX for נָאַץ, קָצַף, רָגַז, etc. ;]
__1. primarily, but never so in cl., to sharpen (μάχαιραν, Dt 32:41, שָׁנַן).
__2. Metaphorical, as always in cl.,
__(a) to spur on, stimulate (Arist., Xen., al.);
__(b) to provoke, rouse to anger (Dt 9:7, 18, Sl 106:29, al.) : pass., At 17:16, 1Co 13:5.†
(AS)

G3948.def:
παροξυσμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(παροξύνω), [in LXX: Dt 29:28, Jr 32:37 (קֶצֶף)* ;]
__1. stimulation, provocation: π. ἀγάπης, Hb 10:14.
__2. irritation: At 15:39.†
(AS)

G3949.def:
παρ-οργίζω
[in LXX chiefly for כַּעַס hi. ;]
(in cl., passive only), to provoke to anger: Rm 10:19 (LXX), Ef 6:4.†
(AS)

G3950.def:
παρ-οργισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(παροργίζω), [in LXX: 3Ki.15:30, 4Ki.23:26 (כַּעַס); 4Ki.19:3, Ne 9:18, 26 (נְאָצָה); Jr 21:5 A (קֶצֶף) * ;]
irritation ("distinguished from ὀργή as implying a less permanent state"; ICC, Eph., 140; and see Tr., Syn., § xxxvii) : Ef 4:26.†
(AS)

G3951.def:
παρ-οτρύνω
to urge on, stir up: with accusative of person(s), At 13:50 (find., Hipp., and late writers).†
(AS)

G3952.def:
παρ-ουσία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: Ne 2:6 A, Jdth.10:18, 2Ma.8:12 2Mac 15:21, 3Ma.3:17 * ;]
__1. usually in cl., a being present, presence: 1Co 16:17, 2Co 10:10; opposite to ἀπουσία, Fp 2:12 (cf. 2Ma.15:21).
__2. a coming, arrival, advent (Soph., Eur., Thuc., al., see LS, see word; so Jth, l.with, 2Ma.8:12) : 2Co 7:6-7, Fp 1:26, 2Ts 2:9; in late writers (see M, Th., 145 ff.; MM, xix; LAE, 372 ff.) as technical term for the visit of a king; hence, in NT, specif. of the Advent or Parousia of Christ : Mt 24:3, 27 24:37, 39, 1Co 15:23, 1Ts 2:19 3:13 4:15 5:23, 2Ts 2:1 2:8, Tg 5:7-8, 2Pe 1:16 3:4 3:12, 1Jo 2:28.†
(AS)

G3953.def:
παρ-οψίς, -ίδος, ἡ
(παρά, ὄψον; see: ὀψάριον),
__1. a side-dish of dainties (Xen., al.).
__2. In Comic poets and late prose, the dish itself on which the dainties are served: Mt 23:25-26 (In this sense it is condemned by the Atticists; see Rutherford, NPhr., 265 f.)†
(AS)

G3954.def:
παρρησία, -ας, ἡ
(πᾶς + ῥῆσις, speech) [in LXX; Lv 26:13 (μετὰ π., קוֺמְמִיּוּת קוֹמְמִיּוּת), Pv 1:20 10:10, Wis.5:1, al. ;]
__1. freedom of speech, plainness, openness, freedom in speaking (Eur., Plat., al.) : At 4:13, 2Co 3:12; παρρησίᾳ, adverbially, freely, openly, plainly, Mc 8:32, Jo 7:13, 26 10:24 11:14 16:29 18:20; opposite to ἐν παροιμίαις, Jo 16:25; ἐν π., Ef 6:19; μετὰ π., At 2:29 4:29, 31 28:31
__2. In LXX (1Ma.4:18, Wis.5:1, al.), FlJ, and NT, also (from the absence of fear which accompanies freedom of speech), confidence, boldness: 2Co 7:4, Fp 1:20, 1Tm 3:13; ἔχειν π., Ef 3:12, Phm 8, Hb 3:6 10:19, 35, 1Jo 2:28 Jn 3:21 Jn 4:17 Jn 5:14; μετὰ π., He 416; ἐν π., Cl 2:15; id. (as בפרהסיא in Rabbinic lit.; see Westc., Jo., i, 262), in public, Jo 7:4 and (without ἐν) Jo 11:54.†
(AS)

G3955.def:
παρρησιάζομαι
(παρρησία), [in LXX: Jó 22:26 (עָנַג hithp.), Sl 12:5 94:1, Pv 20:9, Ct 8:10, Sir.6:11 * ;]
to speak freely or boldly, be bold in speech: At 9:27-28 13:46 14:3 18:26 19:8 26:26, Ef 6:20, 1Ts 2:2.†
(AS)

G3956.def:
πᾶς, πᾶσα, πᾶν, genitive, παντός, πάσης, παντός,
[in LXX chiefly for כֹּל ;]
all, every.
__I. As adj.,
__1. with subst. anarth., all, every, of every kind: Mt 3:10 4:23, Mc 9:49, Lc 4:37, Jo 2:1o, At 27:20, Rm 7:8, Ap 18:17, al. mult.; pl., all, At 22:15, Rm 5:12, Hb 1:6, al.; of the highest degree, π. ἐξουσία (προθυμία, χαρά), Mt 28:18, At 17:11, Phi 2:29, al.; also the whole (though in this sense more frequently with art.), Mt 2:3, At 2:36, Rm 11:26.
__2. C. art. (before the art., after the noun, or, denoting totality, between the art. and noun), all, whole: Mt 8:32 13:2, Mc 5:33, Lc 1:10, At 7:14, Rm 3:19, Gl 5:14, Ef 4:16, al.; pl., Mt 2:4, Mc 4:13, Rm 1:5, al.
__II. As pron.,
__1. masc. and fem., every one: Mc 9:49, Lc 16:16, Hb 2:9; before rel. pron., Mt 7:24, At 2:21, Gl 3:10, al.; with ptcp. (anarth.), Mt 13:19, Lc 11:4; with ptcp. (with art.), Mt 5:22, Mc 7:8, Lc 6:47, Jo 3:8, Rm 1:16, al.; pl., πάντες, absol., all, all men, Mt 10:22, Mc 13:13, Lc 20:38, Jo 1:7 3:26, 1Co 8:1, al.; οἱ π. (collectively, as a definite whole), Rm 11:32, 1Co 1:17, Ef 4:13, al.; π. οἱ (ὅσοι), Mt 4:24, Mc 1:32, Lc 4:40, al.
__2. Neut.,
__(a) sing., πᾶν, everything, all: πᾶν τό, with ptcp., 1Co 10:25, 27, Ef 5:13, 1Jo 2:16 5:4 (sc. ὄν); πᾶν ὅ, Jo 17:2, Rm 14:23; collectively, of persons (Westc., in l.), Jo 6:37, 39; with prep., in adverbial phrases, διὰ παντός, always, Mt 18:10, al.; ἐν παντί, in everything, in every way, 2Co 4:8, Phi 4:6, al.;
__(b) pl., πάτνα, all things: absol., Jo 1:3, 1Co 2:10, Hb 2:8, al.; of certain specified things, Mc 4:34, Lc 1:3, Rm 8:28, 1Ts 5:21, al.; accusative, πάντα, adverbially, wholly, in all things, in all respects, At 20:35, 1Co 9:25, al.; with art., τὰ π., all things (a totality, as distinct from anarth. πάντα, all things severally; cf. Westc, Eph., 186f.), absol.: Rm 11:36, 1Co 8:6, Ef 3:9, Hb 1:3, al.; relatively, Mc 4:11, At 17:25, Rm 8:32, al.; πάντα, with ptcp., Mt 18:31, al.; πάντα ταῦτα (ταῦτα π.), Mt 6:32, 33, al.; πάντα, with prep, in adverbial phrases, πρὸ πάντων, above all things, Tg 5:12, 1Pe 4:8; ἐν π́, in all things, in all ways, 1Tm 3:11, 1Pe 4:11, al.; κατὰ πάντα, in all respects, At 17:22, al.
__3. C. neg., πᾶς οὐ (μή) = οὐδείς, see: οὐ and μή, and cf. M, Pr., 245f.
(AS)

G3957.def:
πάσχα, τό indecl. (Aram. טַּסְחָא),
[in LXX for פֶּסַח ;]
__1. the festival of the Passover: Mt 26:2, Mc 14:1, Lc 22:1, Jo 2:13, 23 6:4 11:55 12:1 18:39 19:14, At 12:4, Hb 11:28; .ἡ ἐορτὴ τοῦ π., Lc 2:41, Jo 13:1.
__2. By meton.,
__(a) the paschal supper: ἑτοιμάζειν τὸ π., Mt 26:19, Mc 14:16, Lc 22:8, 13; ποιεῖν τό π., Mt 26:18;
__(b) the pasohal lamb: θύειν τό π. (Êx 12:21), Mc 14:12, Lc 22:7; of Christ, 1Co 5:7; φαγεῖν τὸ π. (lamb or supper), Mt 26:17, Mc 14:12, 14, Lc 22:11, 15, Jo 18:28 (cf. 2Cr 30:17).†
(AS)

G3958.def:
πάσχω
[in LXX: Am 6:6 (חָלָה ni.), Wis.12:27, Sir.38:16, al. ;]
to suffer, be acted on, as opposite to acting, often limited by a word expressive of good or evil;
__(a) of misfortunes (most frequently without any limiting word) : absol., Lc 22:15 24:46, At 1:3 3:18 17:3, 1Co 12:26, Hb 2:18 9:26 13:12, 1Pe 2:19-20 2:23 3:17 4:15 4:19; before ὑπό, with genitive, Mt 17:12; ὑπέρ, At 9:16, Fp 1:20, 2Ts 1:5, 1Pe 2:21; with dative ref., 1Pe 4:1; περί, with genitive (before ὑπέρ), 1Pe 3:18; διά, with accusative, 1Pe 3:14; ὀλίγον (a little while), 1Pe 5:10; with accusative, Mt 27:19, Mc 9:12, Lc 13:2 24:26, At 28:5, 2Tm 1:12, Hb 5:8, Ap 2:10; παθήματα, 2Co 1:6; ταῦτα, Gl 3:4 (EV; cf. Lft., in l, but see infr.); accusative before ἀπό, Mt 16:21, Lc 9:22 17:25; ὑπό, Mc 5:26, 1Ts 2:14;
__(b) of pleasant experiences (but always with qualifying word, εὖ or accusative of thing(s)) : Gl 3:4 (cf. Grimm-Thayer, see word; Interp. Corn., in l, but see supr.) (cf. προ-, συν-πάσχω).†
(AS)

G3959.def:
Πάταρα, -ων, τὰ
Patara, a maritime city of Lycia: At 21:1.†
(AS)

G3960.def:
πατάσσω
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for נָכָה hi., also for נָגַף, etc. ;]
__1. in Hom., intrans., to beat (of the heart).
__2. Trans. = πλήσσω, to strike, smite: absol., ἐν μαχαίρᾳ, Lc 22:49; with accusative of person(s), Mt 26:51, Lc 22:50; with accusative of thing(s), At 12:7; of a deadly blow, Mt 26:31, Mc 14:27, At 7:24. Metaphorical, of disease: At 12:23, Ap 11:6 19:15.†
(AS)

G3961.def:
πατέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for דָּרַךְ, etc. ;]
__1. intrans., to tread, walk: before ἐπάνω ὄφεων κ.τ.λ. (figuratively), Lc 10:19 (cf. Sl 91:13).
__2. Trans., to tread on, trample: τ. ληνόν, Ap 14:20 19:15 (cf. Jz 9:27, La 1:15, al.); of the desecration of Jerusalem by its enemies, Lc 21:24, Ap 11:2 (cf. κατα-, περι-, ἐν-περι-πατέω).†
(AS)

G3962.def:
πατήρ, πατρός, -τρί, τέρα, [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for אָב ;]
a father;
__1. prop.,
__(a) of the male parent: Mt 2:22, Lc 1:17, Jo 4:53; anarth., Hb 12:7 (M, Pr., 82 f.); pl., of both parents (cl.), Hb 11:23; οἱ π. τ. σαρκός, Hb 12:9;
__(b) of a forefather or ancestor (in cl. usually in pl.; Hom., al.): Mt 3:9, Lc 1:73, Jo 8:39, al.; pl., Mt 23:30, 32 Lc 6:23, 26 Jo 4:20, 1Co 10:1, al.
__2. Metaphorical,
__(a) of an author, originator, or archetype (= αἴτιος, ἀρχηγός, etc.; Pind., Plat., al.): Jo 8:41-44, Rm 4:11, 12 16.
__(b) as a title of respect or honour, used of seniors, teachers and others in a position of responsible authority (Jz 17:10, 2Rs 2:12, Pv 1:8, al.): Mt 23:9 At 7:2 22:1, 1Jo 2:13.
__3. Of God (as in cl. of Zeus) as Father;
__(a) of created things: τ. φώτων, Tg 1:17;
__(b) of all sentient beings: Ef 3:14, 15 Hb 12:9;
__(with) of men, esp. those in covenant relation with Him (freq in OT and later Jewish lit.; see Dalman, Words, 184ff.): Mt 6:4, Lc 6:36, Jo 4:21, Tg 3:9, al.; ὁ π. ὁ ἐν (τ.) οὐρανοῖς, Mt 5:16, Mc 11:25; ὁ π. ὁ οὐράνιος, Mt 6:14 15:13; esp. in the Epp., of Christians: Rm 8:15, 2Co 6:18, Gl 4:6, Ef 2:18 4:6, 1Jo 2:1; with genitive qual., τ. οἰκτιρμῶν, 2Co 1:3; τ. δοξῆς, Ef 1:17;
__(d) of Christ (Dalman, Words, 190 ff.);
__(α) by our Lord himself: ὁ π., Mt 11:25-27, Lc 10:2, 22 Jo 5:20-23, al.; ὁ π. μου, Mt 11:27, al.; ὁ ἐν τ. οὐρανοῖς, Mt 7:11, al.; ὁ οὐράνιος, Mt 15:13; vocat., Jo 11:41 12:27, 28 17:1, 5, 11, 20, 25 (cf. Abbott, JG., 96 f.);
__(β) by Apostles: Jo 1:14 (anarth.; see M, Pr., l.with), Rm 15:6, 2Co 1:3 11:31, Ef 1:3, Cl 1:3, Hb 1:5, 1Pe 1:3, Ap 1:6 (cf. Westc., Epp. Jo., 27-34).
(AS)

G3963.def:
Πάτμος, -ου, ἡ
Patmos, an island in the Ægean Sea: Ap 1:9.†
(AS)

G3964.def:
πατρολῴας (-αλῴας, Rec.; in cl. -αλοίας, see Bl., § 3, 3; 6, 2, and cf. μητρολῴας), -ου, ὁ
(πατήρ + ἀλοιάω, to smite),
__(a) a parricide: 1Tm 1:9 (Av, R, txt.);
__(b) a smiter of his father : ib. (R, mg.).†
(AS)

G3965.def:
πατριά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(πατήρ), [in LXX chiefly for אָב, Êx 6:14, al., also for מִשְׁפָּחָה, Êx 6:15, 4Ki.14:7, Sl 22:27, al. ;]
__1. lineage, ancestry (Hdt.).
__2. = πάτρα (more common in cl.), a family or tribe (so sometimes in Hdt., in LXX of related people, in a sense narrower than φυλή and wider than οἶκος; see Êx 12:3, Nm 32:28): Lc 2:4; in a wider sense (1Cr 16:28, Sl 22:27), At 3:25" (LXX) Ef 3:15.†
(AS)

G3966.def:
πατριάρχης, -ου, ὁ
(πατριά, ἄρχω), [in LXX: 1Cr 24:31 (אָב), 2Cr 19:8 26:12 (אָב רֹאשׁ), 1Cr 27:12 (שַׂר), 2Cr 23:20 (מֵאָה שַׂר), 4Ma.7:19 4Mac 16:25 * ;]
a patriarch: At 2:29 7:8-9, Hb 7:4.†
(AS)

G3967.def:
πατρικίς, -ή, -όν
(πατήρ), [in LXX for אָב, Gn 50:8, al. ;]
paternal, ancestral: Gl 1:14.†
(AS)

G3968.def:
πατρίς, -ίδος, ἡ
(πατήρ), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹלֶדֶת ;]
prop. poët. fern. of πάτριος, of one's fathers; as subst., ἡ π. = πάτρα, fatherland, country, home, native place: At 18:27, WH, mg., Hb 11:14; of one's own town, Mt 13:54, 57, Mc 6:1, 4, Lc 4:23-24, Jo 4:44.†
(AS)

G3970.def:
πατρο-παρά-δοτος, -ον
(πατήρ, παραδίδωμι),
handed down from one's fathers, inherited: 1Pe 1:18 (Diod., al.).†
(AS)

G3971.def:
πατρῷος, -α, -ον
(πατήρ), [in LXX: Pv 27:10 (אָב), Et 7:5, 2 -4Ma.12:1-19 * ;]
of one's fathers, received from one's fathers: At 22:3 24:14 28:17.†
(AS)

G3972G.def:
Παῦλος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. Paulus),
__1. Sergius Paulus: At 13:7.
__2. the Apostle Paul (cf. Σαῦλος): At 13:9, and frequently throughout Ac., Rm 1:1, 1Co 1:1, al., 2Pe 3:15.
(AS)

G3972H.def:
Παῦλος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. Paulus),
__1. Sergius Paulus: At 13:7.
__2. the Apostle Paul (cf. Σαῦλος): At 13:9, and frequently throughout Ac., Rm 1:1, 1Co 1:1, al., 2Pe 3:15.
(AS)

G3973.def:
παύω
[in LXX for כָּלָה pi., etc. ;]
to make to cease, restrain, hinder: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό 1Pe 3:10 (LXX). Mid., to cease, leave off: Lc 8:24 11:1, At 20:1, 1Co 13:8; with ptcp., Lc 5:4, At 5:42 6:13 13:10 20:31 21:32, Ef 1:16, Cl 1:9, Hb 10:2; with genitive, ἀμαρτίας, 1Pe 4:1 (WH, mg., R, txt.); with dative, ib. (WH, txt., R, mg.).†
(AS)

G3974.def:
Πάφος, -ου, ἡ
Paphos, a city in Cyprus: At 13:6, 13 †
(AS)

G3975.def:
παχύνω
(παχύς, thick) [in LXX: Dt 32:15, Is 6:10 (שָׁמֵן), al. ;]
to thicken, fatten; pass., to grow fat. Metaphorical, to make dull or stupid (τ. ψυχάς, Rut.); pass., to wax gross: ἡ καρδία„ Mt 13:15, At 28:27" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G3976.def:
πέδη, -ης, ἡ
(πέζα, the instep), [in LXX for נְחֹשֶׁת, etc. ;]
a fetter: Mc 5:4, Lc 8:29.†
(AS)

G3977.def:
πεδινός, -ή, -όν
(πεδίον, a plain), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁפֵלָה (ἡ π.) ;]
level, plain: Lc 6:17.†
(AS)

G3978.def:
πεζεύω
(πεζός)
to travel on foot or by land: At 20:13.†
(AS)

G3979.def:
πεζός, -ή, -όν
(πούς), [in LXX for רַגְלִי ;]
__1. on foot: Mt 14:13 (WH, mg., R, txt.).
__2. Opp. to going by sea, by land: Mt 14:13 (WH, mg., R, mg.).
__3. As adv., πεζῇ (sc. ὁδῷ), on foot or by land: Mt 1413 (WH, txt.), Mc 6:33.†
(AS)

G3980.def:
πειθαρχέω, -ῶ
(πείθομαι, ἀρχή) [in LXX: Dan LXX 7:27 (שְׁמַע), Sir.33:28, I Et 8:94 * ;]
to obey one in authority, be obedient: Tt 3:1; with dative, At 27:21; θεῷ, At 5:29, 32.†
(AS)

G3982.def:
πείθω,
[in LXX chiefly for בָּטַח בֶּטַח, its parts and derivatives ;]
__(i) Active;
__1. trans., to apply persuasion ("conative" in pres.; see M, Pr., 147), to prevail upon or win over, persuade: absol., Mt 28:14, At 19:26; before περί, with genitive of thing(s), At 19:8; with accusative of person(s), At 12:20 14:19 18:4, 2Co 5:11, Gl 1:10; τ. καρδίας ἡμῶν, 1Jo 3:19; with accusative before περί, At 28:23; with accusative and inf., At 13:43 26:28 (see Field, Notes, 141 ff.); with accusative before ἵνα (Plut.), Mt 27:20.
__2. Intrans., 2 pf. πέποιθα with Pres. sense (see M, Pr., 147, 154; Bl., § 59, 2): to trust, be confident, have confidence: with accusative and inf., Rm 2:19; with accusative ref. (see Ellic., in l) : Fp 1:6, 25; with dative, Fp 1:14, Phm 21; ἑαυτῷ, with inf., 2Co 10:7; before ἐν, Fp 3:3-4; ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι, Fp 2:24; ἐπί, with dative, Mt 27:43 (WH, mg.), Mc 10:24 (T, WH, R, mg., om.), Lc 11:22 18:9, 2Co 1:9, Hb 2:13; ἐπί, with accusative, Mt 27:43 (with dative, WH, mg.); id. before ὅτι, 2Co 2:3, 2Ts 3:4 (see Lft., Notes, 127); εἰς, with accusative of person(s) before ὅτι, Gl 5:10.
(ii) Pass. and mid.;
__1. to be persuaded, believe (see M, Pr., 158) : absol., Lc 16:31, At 17:4 21:14, Hb 13:18; with dative, At 28:24; with accusative and inf., At 26:26; so also pf., πέπεισμαι, πεπεισμένος εἰμί: with accusative ref. before περί, Hb 6:9; with accusative and inf., Lc 20:6; ὅτι, Rm 8:38, 2Tm 1:5 1:12; id. with ἐν κυρίῳ, Rm 14:14; περί, with genitive before ὅτι, Rm 15:14.
__2. to listen to, obey: with dative of person(s), At 5:36-37, 40 23:21 27:11, Rm 2:8, Gl 5:7, Hb 13:17, Tg 3:3 (cf. ἀνα-πείθω).†
Πειθώ, -οῦς, ἡ
__1. Peitho, Persuasion (as a goddess).
__2. per­suasion: ἐν πειθοῖ (so Orig., Eus. and some cursives in 1Co 2:4 for πειθός, which see).†
(AS)

G3983.def:
πεινάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for = רָעֵב ;]
to hunger, be hungry: Mt 4:2 12:1, 3 21:18 25:35, 37 25:42, 44, Mc 2:25 11:12, Lc 1:53 4:2 6:3, Rm 12:20" (LXX), 1Co 4:11 11:21 11:34 Fp 4:12, Ap 7:16; metaphorically, Mt 5:6, Lc 6:21, 25, Jo 6:35.†
(AS)

G3984.def:
πεῖρα, -ας, ἡ
(πειράω), [in LXX: Dt 28:56 (π. λαμβάνειν, נָסָה pi.) Dt 33:8 (מַסָּה), Wis.18:20, 25, 2Ma.8:9, 4Ma.8:1 * ;]
trial, experiment; π. λαμβάνειν, to make trial, have experience of: Hb 11:29, 36 (for exx., see Field, Notes, 232 f.).†
(AS)

G3985G.def:
πειράζω poët. and late prose form of πειράω, which see,
[in LXX for נָסָה pi. ;]
__1. to make proof of (Hom.).
__2. to try, attempt (Luc., Polyb., with inf. (see M, Pr., 205; B1., § 69, 4), At 9:26 16:7 24:6.
__3. In LXX and NT, like Heb. נָסָה, with accusative of person(s), to test, try, prove;
__(a) in a good sense : Jo 6:6, 2Co 13:5, Hb 11:17, Ap 2:2; esp. of trials and af6ictions sent or permitted by God (Gn 22:1, Êx 20:20, Wis.3:5, al.), 1Co 10:13, Hb 2:18 4:15 11:17, 37, Ap 3:10;
__(b) in a bad sense (Apoll. Rhod., 3, 10): of the attempts made to ensnare Jesus in his speech, Mt 16:1 19:3 22:18, 35 Mc 8:11 10:2 12:15, Lc 11:16, Jo 8:6; of temptation to sin, to tempt, Tg 1:13-14 (see Hort, in l), Gl 6:1, Ap 2:10; esp. of temptations of the devil, Mt 4:1, 3 Mc 1:13, Lc 4:2, 1Co 7:5, 1Ts 3:5; ὁ πειράζων, the tempter, Mt 4:3, 1Ts 3:5;
__(with) in bad sense also (Êx 17:2, 7, Nm 14:22, al.), of distrustful testing, trying or challenging of God: At 15:10, 1Co 10:9 (WH, mg., ἐξεπείρασαν), Hb 3:9; τ. πνεῦμα Κυρίου, At 5:9 (of. ἐκ-πειράζω).†
SYN.: δοκιμάζω, q.v (AS)

G3985H.def:
πειράζω poët. and late prose form of πειράω, which see,
[in LXX for נָסָה pi. ;]
__1. to make proof of (Hom.).
__2. to try, attempt (Luc., Polyb., with inf. (see M, Pr., 205; B1., § 69, 4), At 9:26 16:7 24:6.
__3. In LXX and NT, like Heb. נָסָה, with accusative of person(s), to test, try, prove;
__(a) in a good sense : Jo 6:6, 2Co 13:5, Hb 11:17, Ap 2:2; esp. of trials and af6ictions sent or permitted by God (Gn 22:1, Êx 20:20, Wis.3:5, al.), 1Co 10:13, Hb 2:18 4:15 11:17, 37, Ap 3:10;
__(b) in a bad sense (Apoll. Rhod., 3, 10): of the attempts made to ensnare Jesus in his speech, Mt 16:1 19:3 22:18, 35 Mc 8:11 10:2 12:15, Lc 11:16, Jo 8:6; of temptation to sin, to tempt, Tg 1:13-14 (see Hort, in l), Gl 6:1, Ap 2:10; esp. of temptations of the devil, Mt 4:1, 3 Mc 1:13, Lc 4:2, 1Co 7:5, 1Ts 3:5; ὁ πειράζων, the tempter, Mt 4:3, 1Ts 3:5;
__(with) in bad sense also (Êx 17:2, 7, Nm 14:22, al.), of distrustful testing, trying or challenging of God: At 15:10, 1Co 10:9 (WH, mg., ἐξεπείρασαν), Hb 3:9; τ. πνεῦμα Κυρίου, At 5:9 (of. ἐκ-πειράζω).†
SYN.: δοκιμάζω, q.v (AS)

G3985I.def:
πειράζω poët. and late prose form of πειράω, which see,
[in LXX for נָסָה pi. ;]
__1. to make proof of (Hom.).
__2. to try, attempt (Luc., Polyb., with inf. (see M, Pr., 205; B1., § 69, 4), At 9:26 16:7 24:6.
__3. In LXX and NT, like Heb. נָסָה, with accusative of person(s), to test, try, prove;
__(a) in a good sense : Jo 6:6, 2Co 13:5, Hb 11:17, Ap 2:2; esp. of trials and af6ictions sent or permitted by God (Gn 22:1, Êx 20:20, Wis.3:5, al.), 1Co 10:13, Hb 2:18 4:15 11:17, 37, Ap 3:10;
__(b) in a bad sense (Apoll. Rhod., 3, 10): of the attempts made to ensnare Jesus in his speech, Mt 16:1 19:3 22:18, 35 Mc 8:11 10:2 12:15, Lc 11:16, Jo 8:6; of temptation to sin, to tempt, Tg 1:13-14 (see Hort, in l), Gl 6:1, Ap 2:10; esp. of temptations of the devil, Mt 4:1, 3 Mc 1:13, Lc 4:2, 1Co 7:5, 1Ts 3:5; ὁ πειράζων, the tempter, Mt 4:3, 1Ts 3:5;
__(with) in bad sense also (Êx 17:2, 7, Nm 14:22, al.), of distrustful testing, trying or challenging of God: At 15:10, 1Co 10:9 (WH, mg., ἐξεπείρασαν), Hb 3:9; τ. πνεῦμα Κυρίου, At 5:9 (of. ἐκ-πειράζω).†
SYN.: δοκιμάζω, q.v (AS)

G3986G.def:
πειρασμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(πειράζω), [in LXX for מַסָּה, עִנְיָן ;]
__1. = πεῖρα, an experiment Diosc.).
__2. a trial, of ethical purpose and effect, whether good or evil (see Hort on Tg 1:13)
__(a) in good or neutral sense: Gl 4:14, Tg 1:12, 1Pe 4:12; esp. of afflictions sent by God (Dt 7:19, Sir.21:1-28, al.): 2Pe 2:9, Ap 3:10; pl., Lc 22:28, At 20:19, Tg 1:2, 1Pe 1:6;
__(b) of trial regarded as leading to sin, temptation: Lc 8:13, 1Co 10:13, 1Tm 6:9; of the temptation of Jesus by the devil, Lc 4:13; εἰσφέρειν (ἔρχεσθαι, εἰσέρχ-) εἰς π., Mt 6:13 26:41, Mc 14:38, Lc 11:4 22:40, 46;
__(with) of the testing or challenge of God by man (see: πειράζω, 3, with) : Hb 3:8 (LXX: Sl 95:9, where κατα τ. ἡμέραν πειρασμοῦ = מַסָּה the day of Massah).†
SYN.: δοκίμιον (AS)

G3986H.def:
πειρασμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(πειράζω), [in LXX for מַסָּה, עִנְיָן ;]
__1. = πεῖρα, an experiment Diosc.).
__2. a trial, of ethical purpose and effect, whether good or evil (see Hort on Tg 1:13)
__(a) in good or neutral sense: Gl 4:14, Tg 1:12, 1Pe 4:12; esp. of afflictions sent by God (Dt 7:19, Sir.21:1-28, al.): 2Pe 2:9, Ap 3:10; pl., Lc 22:28, At 20:19, Tg 1:2, 1Pe 1:6;
__(b) of trial regarded as leading to sin, temptation: Lc 8:13, 1Co 10:13, 1Tm 6:9; of the temptation of Jesus by the devil, Lc 4:13; εἰσφέρειν (ἔρχεσθαι, εἰσέρχ-) εἰς π., Mt 6:13 26:41, Mc 14:38, Lc 11:4 22:40, 46;
__(with) of the testing or challenge of God by man (see: πειράζω, 3, with) : Hb 3:8 (LXX: Sl 95:9, where κατα τ. ἡμέραν πειρασμοῦ = מַסָּה the day of Massah).†
SYN.: δοκίμιον (AS)

G3987.def:
πειράω more commonly as depon., πειράομαι,
[in LXX for נָסָה ;]
to try, attempt: At 26:21.†
(AS)

G3988.def:
πεισμονή, -ῆς, ἡ
(πείθω),
persuasion: Gl 5:8.†
πείθω,
[in LXX chiefly for בָּטַח בֶּטַח, its parts and derivatives ;]
__(i) Active;
__1. trans., to apply persuasion ("conative" in pres.; see M, Pr., 147), to prevail upon or win over, persuade: absol., Mt 28:14, At 19:26; before περί, with genitive of thing(s), At 19:8; with accusative of person(s), At 12:20 14:19 18:4, 2Co 5:11, Gl 1:10; τ. καρδίας ἡμῶν, 1Jo 3:19; with accusative before περί, At 28:23; with accusative and inf., At 13:43 26:28 (see Field, Notes, 141 ff.); with accusative before ἵνα (Plut.), Mt 27:20.
__2. Intrans., 2 pf. πέποιθα with Pres. sense (see M, Pr., 147, 154; Bl., § 59, 2): to trust, be confident, have confidence: with accusative and inf., Rm 2:19; with accusative ref. (see Ellic., in l) : Fp 1:6, 25; with dative, Fp 1:14, Phm 21; ἑαυτῷ, with inf., 2Co 10:7; before ἐν, Fp 3:3-4; ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι, Fp 2:24; ἐπί, with dative, Mt 27:43 (WH, mg.), Mc 10:24 (T, WH, R, mg., om.), Lc 11:22 18:9, 2Co 1:9, Hb 2:13; ἐπί, with accusative, Mt 27:43 (with dative, WH, mg.); id. before ὅτι, 2Co 2:3, 2Ts 3:4 (see Lft., Notes, 127); εἰς, with accusative of person(s) before ὅτι, Gl 5:10.
(ii) Pass. and mid.;
__1. to be persuaded, believe (see M, Pr., 158) : absol., Lc 16:31, At 17:4 21:14, Hb 13:18; with dative, At 28:24; with accusative and inf., At 26:26; so also pf., πέπεισμαι, πεπεισμένος εἰμί: with accusative ref. before περί, Hb 6:9; with accusative and inf., Lc 20:6; ὅτι, Rm 8:38, 2Tm 1:5 1:12; id. with ἐν κυρίῳ, Rm 14:14; περί, with genitive before ὅτι, Rm 15:14.
__2. to listen to, obey: with dative of person(s), At 5:36-37, 40 23:21 27:11, Rm 2:8, Gl 5:7, Hb 13:17, Tg 3:3 (cf. ἀνα-πείθω).†
(AS)

G3989.def:
πέλαγος, -ους, τό
[in LXX: 2Ma.5:21, 4Ma.7:1 * ;]
the deep sea, the deep, the sea: At 27:5; τὸ π. τῆς θαλάσσης, Mt 18:6
SYN.: θαλάσσα (which see); and cf. ἄβυσσος (AS)

G3990.def:
πελεκίζω
(πέλεκυς, a battle-axe),
to out off with an axe, esp. to behead: with accusative, Ap 20:4 (Polyb., al.).†
(AS)

G3991.def:
πέμπτος, -η, -ον
[in LXX for חֲמִישִׁי and cognate forms ;]
fifth: Ap 6:9 9:1 16:10 21:20.†
(AS)

G3992.def:
πέμπω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַח ;]
to send;
__(a) of persons: with accusative, absol., Mt 22:7, Lc 7:19, Jo 1:22, 2Co 9:3, al.; ptcp. before verb., Mt 14:10, At 19:31, al.; ptcp. before διά (= Heb. יָד;, 1Rs 16:20, al.), Mt 11:2 (cf. Ap 1:1); of teachers sent by God, Jo 1:33 4:34, Rm 8:3, al.; with accusative and dative, 1Co 4:17, Fp 2:19; before πρός, with accusative, Lc 4:26, Jo 16:7, al.; before λέγων (cf. Heb. אָמַר שָׁלַח Gn 38:25, al.), Lc 7:6, 19; before εἰς, with accusative loc., Mt 2:8, Lc 15:15, al.; before εἰς (of purpose), Ef 6:22, Cl 4:8, 1Pe 2:14; with inf., Jo 1:33, 1Co 16:3, Ap 22:16;
__(b) of things : Ap 11:10; before εἰς, Ap 1:11; id., of purpose, At 11:29, Fp 4:16; with dative of person(s), 2Ts 2:11; π. τ. δρέπανον σου (cf. εξαποστείλατε δρέπανα = מַגָּל שָׁלַח, Jl 3:13), Ap 14:15, 18 (cf. ἀνα-, ἐκ-, μετα-, προ-, συν-πέμπω)
SYN.: ἀποστέλλω, q.v (AS)

G3993.def:
πένης, -ητος, ὁ
(πένομαι, to work for one's daily bread), [in LXX for אֶבְיוֹן, עָנִי, דַּל, etc. ;]
one who works for his living, a labourer, a poor man: 2Co 9:9.†
SYN.: πτωχός, properly a beggar and implying deeper poverty than π. (see Tr., Syn., § xxxvi, Abbott, Essays, 78) (AS)

G3994.def:
πενθερά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(fem. of πενθερός), [in LXX for חֲמוֹת ;]
a mother-in-law: Mt 8:14 10:35, Mc 1:30, Lc 4:38 12:53.†
(AS)

G3995.def:
πενθερός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for חָם, Gn 38:13, al.; also for חָתַן, Jz 1:16 A ;]
a father-in-law: Jo 18:13.†
(AS)

G3996.def:
πενθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for אָבַל ;]
to mourn (for), lament;
__(a) intrans. : Mt 5:4 (5) Mt 9:15, 1Co 5:2; π. καὶ κλαίειν, Mt 16:10, Lc 6:25, Tg 4:9, Ap 18:15, 19; before ἐπί, with accusative, Ap 18:11;
__(b) trans., with accusative, 2Co 12:21.†
SYN.: see: θρηνέω (AS)

G3997.def:
πένθος, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for אֵבֶל ;]
mourning: Tg 4:9, Ap 18:7-8 21:4.†
(AS)

G3998.def:
πενιχρός, -ά, -όν
(πένομαι, see: πένης) [in LXX: Êx 22:25 (עָנִי), Pv 28:15 29:7 (דַּל) * ;]
chiefly in Comic poets and late prose (but Plato, Rep., 578 A), = πένης,
needy, poor: Lc 21:2 (for ex. in π., see MM, xix).†
(AS)
